pages.text: $(bold)Soul Tether$() — Minions deal +15% damage. All summoned entities are empowered.$(br2)$(bold)Dark Pact$() — Minion damage heals you for 5% of damage dealt. pages.text: The $(thing)Void Summoner$() pairs best with Occultism's summoning system (T3) and Iron's Spells summon spells.
